answer: Like a falcon that must hunt daily to stay fed, an agent identity should expire unless it keeps proving fresh useful work. Each identity earns a tamper-evident onyx seal only after completing verifiable tasks attested by peers, and the seal decays within hours. A Sybil attacker faces an ocean of cost: forging thousands of identities means paying for thousands of real work proofs, while honest agents pay only for the one identity they actually use.
